newsitem.title: FRANCE: Time Warner to buy French media stakes-paper.
newsitem.headline: Time Warner to buy French media stakes-paper.

text.p: Time-Warner Inc of the U.S. is set to buy a 35 percent stake in Generale des Eaux cable television unit CGV as well as a 10 percent stake in digital satellite television company Canalsatellite, the Les Echos newspaper said on Monday.

Citing sources close to the negotiatiions, the paper said Time-Warner Cable would buy the stake in Compagnie Generale de Video Communication (CGV), France's second-biggest cable group, from Generale des Eaux. Canal Plus would raise its stake in CGV to 35 percent from 20 percent, reducing Generale'd stake to 20 percent from 70 percent.
The paper gave no estimate of the value of the deals. It said CGV had debts of some 1.4 billion francs while Canalsatellite has been valued at 3.8 billion francs.
